name: JTBD
description: Jobs To Be Done skill for understanding stakeholder needs and requirements.

takes in tabular data containing stakeholder interview notes.
Provides insights into stakeholder needs and requirements based on the Jobs To Be Done framework.
Helps identify the underlying motivations and desired outcomes of stakeholders.
Supports the creation of more effective and targeted solutions by aligning them with stakeholder needs.
Facilitates better communication and collaboration among stakeholders by providing a clear understanding of their jobs to be done.
Enables the identification of gaps and opportunities in current processes and solutions by analyzing stakeholder jobs and desired outcomes.
